learning_outcomes.text: The student will learn to synthesize the knowledge and competencies acquired during the other subjects of the degree, with special emphasis on those related to Electrical Engineering / Industrial Electronics and Automatic Engineering / Mechanical Engineering / Materials Engineering / Industrial Technologies.

assessment_methods.method: Defense before questions posed by the Evaluating Tribunal

assessment_rules: The final grade (CF) for the subject will be calculated as follows: CF = 0.7 x CM + 0.3 x CP, where CM is the written report evaluation and CP is the public defense evaluation. This subject cannot be evaluated by a global exam. Specific minimum marks or resit arrangements beyond the existence of an extraordinary call are not detailed.
